Construction / General contracting

GEO for commercial and industrial construction contractors

I test which firms AI assistants recommend for those decisions, then identify missing evidence on the company website and in third-party sources.

Selection barriers

Why general contractor recommendations become unreliable

AI answers can combine developers, lead designers, fabricators and construction contractors into an undifferentiated list.

01

Projects are attributed to the wrong contractor

A company may have supplied materials or completed one package without managing the entire build. The contract role, delivery stage and evidence must be clear.

02

Turnkey claims hide exclusions

Groundworks, utility connections, commissioning and fit-out are often contracted separately. Without a documented scope, headline prices and comparisons mislead clients.

03

Qualifications are overstated

SRO requirements and contracting rights depend on the work and contractual circumstances. Service area and time claims also need real capacity behind them.

Buyer intents

Procurement questions worth measuring

Different project decisions require separate prompts and evidence, not one generic construction search.

Buyer questionEvidence to checkGEO improvement
Which contractors build logistics hubs in our region?Comparable warehouses, contractor role, region and delivery stageShow substantiated logistics projects and the work actually done
Who can act as general contractor for a factory?Facility type, engineering systems, responsibility and applicable qualificationsDocument industrial specialisms and scope of responsibility
Who can reconstruct an operating factory?Operational constraints, safety, practical experience and approvalsDistinguish refurbishment from new construction without zero-downtime promises
How should we compare bids and project stages?Bill of work, exclusions, milestones, handover and liabilitiesExplain contract stages and evidence rather than inventing fixed prices
Verifiable facts

Evidence behind a responsible contractor recommendation

Articles 52 and 55.8 of the Russian Town Planning Code set out responsibilities and applicable membership conditions. They do not certify an individual contractor's record. Each claim must be checked against real contracts, project evidence and the current legal position.

  • Projects: building category, location, year, actual contractor role, performed stages and approved-to-share records
  • Company: correct legal entity, applicable SRO status, disciplines, regional scope and contractual responsibility
  • Delivery: defined work packages, coordination responsibilities, schedule conditions and handover procedures

GAEO applies an evidence-led B2B GEO methodology; this page does not assert an existing general-contractor client outcome.

Scope of work

How I develop a general contractor GEO programme

The work follows the procurement decision, then builds better evidence and measurable AI visibility.

  1. 01

    Map procurement intent

    Separate warehouses, industrial buildings, commercial developments, new construction and reconstruction, then record baseline BMR.

  2. 02

    Audit the portfolio

    Verify what the company delivered, its role, references, applicable credentials and market boundaries.

  3. 03

    Improve the information architecture

    Plan project records, specialty pages, work-scope descriptions, FAQs and relevant independent publications.

  4. 04

    Measure comparable answers

    Repeat the prompt matrix, track recommendation share and review whether assistants describe the firm's actual responsibilities correctly.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a contractor improve GEO without a large public portfolio?+

Yes, if its genuine services and documented capabilities can be explained. Do not invent completed facilities or turn supplier references into general-contracting achievements.

Is mentioning SRO membership enough?+

No. The status and its applicability to the actual work and contract must be checked. No generic badge authorizes every possible project.

Does a warehouse differ from an industrial plant in GEO?+

Yes. Facility operation, engineering systems, delivery constraints and buyer criteria differ, so both prompts and supporting evidence should be segmented.

Does schema markup guarantee an AI recommendation?+

No. Structured data clarifies facts but cannot control AI responses. GAEO measures baseline BMR and later changes using comparable questions.

What does GEO for general contractors cost?+

The published GAEO plans apply. Scope depends on building types, territories, verifiable case studies and the prompt matrix.
